verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical: the headline is crammed against a narrow right column, with the period after 'sunshine.' nearly touching the CTA. The subcopy breaks into four centered lines and ends on an orphaned 'flavours.'. In A the subcopy and button sit together and are centered vertically against the headline. In B a looser gap pushes the button lower, closer to the bottom edge and out of line with the headline, so A is marginally better.
